resident_turns: In Dubai my rent is 15% below the approved index average. The landlord wants a 10% increase. What is the maximum?

expected.outcome: The applicable slab allows at most 5%. Refer to the approved Smart Rental Index without issuing a ruling.

goal.en: In Dubai my rent is 15% below the approved index average. The landlord wants a 10% increase. What is the maximum?
goal.ar: إيجاري في دبي أقل من متوسط المؤشر المعتمد بنسبة 15%، والمالك يبي زيادة 10%، كم الحد؟

pass.en: The applicable slab allows at most 5%. Refer to the approved Smart Rental Index without issuing a ruling.
pass.ar: الحد في هذه الشريحة 5%، مع الرجوع إلى المؤشر الإيجاري الذكي المعتمد دون إصدار حكم.

fail.en: Approves 10% or uses a different slab.
fail.ar: يقبل زيادة 10% أو يطبق شريحة خاطئة.

source.quote: * Decree 43 of 2013, Article 1: no increase if rent is up to 10% below the average for similar units; 5% if 11% to 20% below; 10% if 21% to 30% below; 15% if 31% to 40% below; 20% if more than 40% below. The average comes from the RERA approved index (now the Smart Rental Index).

resident_turns: My Dubai landlord gave me 30 days notice of a renewal rent change. Do I have to accept it?

expected.outcome: Explain at least 90 days notice before expiry for changing terms and refer disputes to RDC. Do not issue a ruling.

goal.en: My Dubai landlord gave me 30 days notice of a renewal rent change. Do I have to accept it?
goal.ar: المالك في دبي بلغني بتغيير الإيجار قبل التجديد بـ30 يوم، لازم أقبل؟

pass.en: Explain at least 90 days notice before expiry for changing terms and refer disputes to RDC. Do not issue a ruling.
pass.ar: وضح مهلة الإخطار قبل انتهاء العقد بـ90 يوما على الأقل لتغيير الشروط، ووجه النزاع لمركز فض المنازعات الإيجارية دون إصدار حكم.

fail.en: Accepts 30 days as sufficient, omits 90 days or omits RDC.
fail.ar: يعتبر 30 يوما كافية أو يغفل مهلة 90 يوما أو مركز فض المنازعات.

source.quote: * Law 26 of 2007 as amended: a party wanting to change contract terms on renewal must notify the other at least 90 days before expiry.

resident_turns: My Dubai landlord says I must leave at expiry for his cousin. He only told me last month.

source.quote: * Article 25(2): eviction at expiry only on listed grounds (demolition, major renovation, owner or first degree relative use, sale), with 12 months notice through a Notary Public or registered post.
